Interesting ketiv/qere cases in NAEE

Features of interest · NAEE book links · Dataset documentation

Ketiv is the primary text, with pointed qere above it at the same size and CLC's box around the pair. When qere is wider, the shorter ketiv is centered beneath it. Each heading's verse reference opens the verse in NAEE, with its surrounding text and notes.

  1. 2 Samuel 8:3 — a wide qere
  2. Isaiah 54:16 — a wider single-atom qere
  3. Genesis 30:11 — two qere atoms
  4. Qere without ketiv
  5. Isaiah 26:20 — a yod in the ketiv
  6. 1 Chronicles 9:4 — a two-atom qere inside a maqaf compound

2 Samuel 8:3 — a wide qere

The qere is a maqaf compound above a shorter ketiv atom. Look at the space reserved for the pair in the verse.

וַיַּ֣ךְ דָּוִ֔ד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן־רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהָשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר(בִּֽנְהַר־פְּרָֽת)׃

Isaiah 54:16 — a wider single-atom qere

The qere is a single atom wider than the ketiv beneath it.

הִןֵּ֤(הִנֵּ֤ה) אָנֹכִי֙ בָּרָ֣אתִי חָרָ֔שׁ נֹפֵחַ֙ בְּאֵ֣שׁ פֶּחָ֔ם וּמוֹצִ֥יא כְלִ֖י לְמַעֲשֵׂ֑הוּ וְאָנֹכִ֛י בָּרָ֥אתִי מַשְׁחִ֖ית לְחַבֵּֽל׃

Genesis 30:11 — two qere atoms

The qere has two atoms separated by a space above one ketiv atom.

וַתֹּ֥אמֶר לֵאָ֖ה בָּ֣גָ֑ד(בָּ֣א גָ֑ד) וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ גָּֽד׃

Qere without ketiv

Ruth 3:5 and Judges 20:13 show qere without ketiv. NAEE puts the editorial label “no ketiv” on the baseline. That label occupies space beneath the qere.

Ruth 3:5

וַתֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֑יהָ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמְרִ֥י [אין כתיב](אֵלַ֖י) אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃

Judges 20:13

וְעַתָּ֡ה תְּנוּ֩ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּגִּבְעָה֙ וּנְמִיתֵ֔ם וּנְבַעֲרָ֥ה רָעָ֖ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ [אין כתיב](בְּנֵ֣י) בִנְיָמִ֔ן לִשְׁמֹ֕עַ בְּק֖וֹל אֲחֵיהֶ֥ם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

Isaiah 26:20 — a yod in the ketiv

The ketiv דלתיך has a yod absent from the qere דלתך. Compare the pointing and width of the two readings.

לֵ֤ךְ עַמִּי֙ בֹּ֣א בַחֲדָרֶ֔יךָ וּֽסֲגֹ֥ר דְּלָתְיךָ֖(דְּלָֽתְךָ֖) בַּעֲדֶ֑ךָ חֲבִ֥י כִמְעַט־רֶ֖גַע עַד־יַעֲבָור־זָֽעַם׃

1 Chronicles 9:4 — a two-atom qere inside a maqaf compound

The single ketiv atom בנימן has a two-atom qere. The pair sits inside a longer maqaf compound, with maqafs on both sides; inspect the space between the qere atoms and the connections to neighboring atoms.

עוּתַ֨י בֶּן־עַמִּיה֤וּד בֶּן־עָמְרִי֙ בֶּן־אִמְרִ֣י בֶן־בָּנִ֔ימִן־(בָּנִ֔י מִן־)בְּנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ בֶּן־יְהוּדָֽה׃
